body_markdown:
SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 22, 2026-- Visa (NYSE: V) today announced its participation in the following investor conferences.


On Monday, November 9, Chris Suh, Chief Financial Officer, will present at the Citi FinTech Conference. The discussion will begin at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 35 minutes.


On Tuesday, November 10, Andrew Torre, President, Value-Added Services, will present at the KBW Fintech Ecosystem Conference. The discussion will begin at 1:55 p.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 40 minutes.


On Tuesday, December 1, Mr. Suh will present at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference. The discussion will begin at 8:15 a.m. Mountain Time and last for approximately 30 minutes.


On Tuesday, December 8, Ryan McInerney, Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Wells Fargo TMT Summit. The discussion will begin at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time and last for approximately 35 minutes.


Listen-only audio webcasts and replays will be accessible for 30 days following each event and available on the Investor Relations website at[investor.visa.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.visa.com%2F&esheet=54627294&newsitemid=20261022185316&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.visa.com&index=1&md5=611234136a329686bdde399c1a4c11d5) .


About Visa


Visa (NYSE: V) is a world leader in digital payments, facilitating transactions between consumers, sellers, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses and economies to thrive. We believe that economies that include everyone everywhere, uplift everyone everywhere and see access as foundational to the future of money movement. Learn more at[Visa.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.visa.com&esheet=54627294&newsitemid=20261022185316&lan=en-US&anchor=Visa.com&index=2&md5=f6579eebe5ca729305cb44b1413f7b0d) .
